title: Quarterly FOIA Report
description: Each quarter, agencies must provide the number of requests received, processed, and in the agency's backlog. Additionally, agencies must report the status of the agency's ten oldest pending requests each quarter.

contactPoint.fn: Data Management US Department of Justice (USDOJ)

distribution.description: This is a JSON API endpoint for the quarterly report data as it is stored in the Drupal backend. An access token is required and can be created here: https://www.foia.gov/developer/#api-key-signup
distribution.title: Quarterly Report JSON API
